posts.title: The Renaissance of Gaming
posts.description: Over the past few days I’ve been collecting tweets about people using AI to reverse-engineer games, build ports, and get them running on different hardware. I wanted to understand how much of this was real, and the more I looked into it, the more interesting it became. I started thinking, “this is a new Renaissance for Gaming”. posts.description: DeepSeek Sparse Attention , some considerations about it after reading the paper. DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp is defined as an experimental sparse-attention model . posts.title: Qwen3-Max and other Qwen releases
posts.description: Qwen3-Max has been released from Qwen team. It’s their largest and most advanced large language model to date. It competes against GPT-5 and Grok 4. The base model has over 1 trillion parameters and was pretrained on 36 trillion tokens . Its architecture seems to follow the same of other models from Qwen3 series: it provides a highly optimized MoE design, which activates only a subset of parameter
